combo_label: Jobs & Professions × Musical Instruments × Samurai & Feudal Japan

entries.clue: Scans the pool from a high chair, whistle ready and float within reach
Curved single-edged blade worn slung with its cutting edge upward
Masterless swordsman adrift after his house was broken
Sovereign who reigned in the old capital while warriors did the ruling
Raised wooden clog that clacks and keeps a long hem clear of mud
Two feet of silver blown sideways across a hole, airy and pure up at the top
Tall folded wooden body, the orchestra's low-voiced clown with a curved crook
Member of the hereditary warrior caste, entitled to a surname and two blades
Shallow drum with rattling wires beneath, giving a marching beat its crack
Scrubs in, opens with a scalpel and closes the wound with neat sutures
Deep-voiced strings gripped between the knees and sung by a horsehair bow
Cuts and beds stone, tapping each course true against a taut line
Rice brew warmed in a flask and poured for a guest, never for oneself
